xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Last disclosure made on 19th January 2024: The authority issued Form GST DRC-7A in lieu of Assessment Order 2013 – 14 referring to a penalty of Rs. 10,000/-. The Company had already filed an appeal challenging the Assessment Order 2013-14 in 2018 which is pending final adjudication. The Company shall assess Form GST DRC-7A and take necessary steps in consultation with our legal advisors.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Deputy Commissioner passed an order and dismissed the appeal filed by the company due to non-deposit of pre-deposit of additional demand required to entertain the appeal. The Company has duly paid the pre-deposit to contest the appeal and has accordingly challenged the order of Deputy Commissioner by filing appropriate appeal before the Tribunal.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Additional Commissioner Of CGST & C.Ex, Ranchi
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Last disclosure made on 2nd February 2025: Penalty of Rs. 44,38,72,605/- under relevant provisions of CGST Act 2017 read with relevant provisions of IGST Act, 2017 and GST (Compensation to States Act), 2017 has been imposed. The said penalty has been levied on allegation of wrong availment / excess utilization / claim of inadmissible Input Tax Credit, non-payment/short payment of GST pertaining to the period July 2017 to 31st March 2022. The Company strongly objects to the levy of such a penalty and is in the process of taking adequate steps to contest the said Order before appropriate appellate authorities within the stipulated time.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Commissioner of Appeals, Ranchi passed an order granting substantial relief to the Company. Further, certain smaller demands on blocked ITC and residual RCM liabilities have been sustained. The Company is evaluating the further course of action on the sustained demands.
